sections.changelog:
Added

  • **Category filter for feeds.** The Feeds screen now has a "Feed Categories" picker that controls which product categories are exported to the generated feeds — the same include/exclude tree used for import, but working on the site's own WooCommerce categories. Ticking a parent covers its whole branch, the choice applies to the general feed and every per-warehouse feed, and leaving everything unticked exports all categories (unchanged default). Products and the feed's category tree stay in lock-step, so nothing outside the selection leaks in.
